title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 129
description: Ten questions on Psalms 129: the long affliction of Israel, the plowers on its back and those who hate Zion.

questions.text: Since when does the speaker say they have afflicted him many times?
questions.explanation: Psalms 129:1 says many times they have afflicted him from his youth up.

questions.text: Who is called on to say, "Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up"?
questions.explanation: Psalms 129:1 says, "Let Israel now say" these words.

questions.text: Although they afflicted him many times, what does verse 2 say his enemies have not done?
questions.explanation: Psalms 129:2 says they afflicted him many times, yet they have not prevailed against him.

questions.text: Where did the plowers plow, according to verse 3?
questions.explanation: Psalms 129:3 says the plowers plowed on his back.

questions.text: What did the plowers make long?
questions.explanation: Psalms 129:3 says they made their furrows long.

questions.text: What has the righteous Yahweh cut apart?
questions.explanation: Psalms 129:4 says Yahweh is righteous and has cut apart the cords of the wicked.

questions.text: Who should be disappointed and turned backward?
questions.explanation: Psalms 129:5 asks that all those who hate Zion be disappointed and turned backward.

questions.text: To what are those who hate Zion compared in verse 6?
questions.explanation: Psalms 129:6 says, "Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up."

questions.text: Who does not fill his hand with this withered grass?
questions.explanation: Psalms 129:7 says the reaper doesn't fill his hand with it, nor he who binds sheaves his bosom.

questions.text: What blessing do those who go by NOT say?
questions.explanation: Psalms 129:8 says those who go by do not say, "The blessing of Yahweh be on you."

answers.text: "The blessing of Yahweh be on you"
"Go up to the house of God"
